detail.longDescription: Cut a new security-focused release of `pypi-publish` v1.14.3. It features my deptree hash-pinning work and on top of it, @ sethmlarson also removed some revoked CAs from certifi-shipped TLS trust store in the deptree that might affect Sigstore-related components.
